title.narrative: UNDP DR PLANT Biodiversity Conservation and Sustainable Utilization Project ?

description.narrative: The project involves carrying out the mainstreaming of biodiversity conservation international standards for enterprises and developing key standards. It focuses on typical ethnic minority villages in Yunnan Province as demonstration sites, establishing in situ conservation of alpine plant genetic resources such as Prinsepia utilis Royle and Adenosma buchneroides Bonati, and sustainable use and access and benefit sharing (ABS) community demonstrations. condition.narrative: Consistent with the Article III of the SBAA [or the Supplemental Provisions to the Project Document], the responsibility for the safety and security of the Implementing Partner and its personnel and property, and of UNDP’s property in the Implementing Partner’s custody, rests with the Implementing Partner. To this end, the Implementing Partner shall: a) put in place an appropriate security plan and maintain the security plan, taking into account the security situation in the country where the project is being carried; b) assume all risks and liabilities related to the Implementing Partner’s security, and the full implementation of the security plan.

Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

comment.narrative:
More than 20 national standards related to environmental management and biodiversity conservation were studied.
The first draft of the international standard for Biodiversity Conservation Guidelines for Raw Material Production Areas of Cosmetics Manufacturers is finished. Focusing on biodiversity conservation, the draft explores the principles of biodiversity conservation on raw material production areas of cosmetics manufacturers, biodiversity impact assessment, biodiversity management, biodiversity conservation campaigns, ABS of genetic resources, management of alien species, etc.

comment.narrative:
Develop the distribution map of Prinsepia Utilis Royle resources in China, establish 50 mu (3.3 hectares) germplasm resource area of Prinsepia Utilis Royle in Yangbi County, Yunnan Province. Carry out the demonstration of artificial high-yield cultivation of Prinsepia Utilis Royle through the NBS method.
This project team applied for certification of the improved asexual varieties of 'Dianqing No. 5' and 'Dianqing No. 6' to the Yunnan Provincial Improved Tree Variety Certification Committee in August 2024 (the on-site inspection was completed in May, and the review was conducted in June).
